newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BLANC MARKS RETURN TO FRANCE WITH TWO GOALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLANC MARKS RETURN TO FRANCE WITH TWO GOALS.

text.p: France defender Laurent Blanc, newly signed from Barcelona, scored twice in six minutes on his debut as Marseille came from behind to beat Le Havre 3-1 at home in the French first division on Saturday.

Paris St Germain also relied on new signings Florian Maurice and Marco Simone for their first goal in a 2-0 home win over promoted Chateauroux, the France striker netting a ball from the Italian in the 49th minute.
Both sides, aspirants to the title held by Monaco, made a better start to the season than the champions who went down 1-0 at Bordeaux on Friday.

Lens, who beat 1996 champions Auxerre 3-0 at home, have the best record of the opening weekend of the season. Marseille and Guingamp, 3-1 winners against Cannes with two goals from striker Lionel Rouxel, are joint second.
